purpose: Diagnostic baseline only. DPIDR checks do not establish full memory-transfer acceptance.
build: python tools/run_vivado.py -mode batch -notrace -nojournal -source fpga/make_swd_io_variant.tcl -tclargs build/minimal_swd/slow16.bit SLOW 16 build/minimal_swd/minimal_swd.runs/impl_1/minimal_swd_top_routed.dcp swclk
observations: Same routed design: SLOW/4 reproduces ACK5/data FE3F019F; SLOW/16 gives ACK1/DPIDR 1BA01477/correct parity at nominal 10kHz, 100kHz and 1MHz; switching back to SLOW/4 reproduces the error.
Pad-edge counter equals intended 200 rising edges in both passing and failing cases. No sticky unexpected edge was detected at the FPGA pad.
Production design with its output-only clock pad still fails low frequencies with SLOW/16. This is not a production fix.
limits: FPGA-side digital counters cannot prove the analog waveform at the target MCU pin, and can miss sub-spec pulses.

Old ctrlstat_prediction.json and slow16_ctrlstat.json are excluded: they requested CTRL/STAT immediately after line reset without the mandatory successful DPIDR read. ACK7 from those tests is not valid fault evidence. The runner now permits DPIDR only.
Nominal GPIO rate excludes software/MMIO overhead. FCLK is fixed at 100MHz.
